prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style: hand-painted stylized game art, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, mid-level detail, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous, never grim. The palette's warm gold and cool teal are painted into the surfaces, but the light is flat, even studio light: no strong key light, no cast shadows, no rim light. Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Game-asset reference sheet for 3D modelling, wide landscape 16:9. Plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, no clouds, no floating rock, no ground plane, a soft contact shadow only. Every piece fully isolated with clear space around it, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the edge, arranged in tidy rows, each with a small neat hand-lettered label underneath. MODULAR KIT PIECES sheet: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same pieces, their order, names and sizes. Accord town style on a 2 m module, 3 m storey, 0.5 m walls: ground floors Anchorkin dark basalt with teal crystal veins and round arches, upper floors Rootwarden silver-grey deadwood timber frames with plaster infill and moss and small flowers at the joints. Row 1 foundations: "Basalt Plinth 2 x 1 m", "Slope Step 2 x 1 m (run 1.5 m)", "Dock-edge Foundation 2 x 1 m" (with iron mooring ring). Row 2 ground-floor basalt walls, each 2 x 3 m and 0.5 m thick: "Arcade Wall – Plain" (blind round arch relief), "Arcade Wall – Window" (round-arched 1 x 1.5 m opening with empty or simple glazing), "Arcade Wall – Door" (round-arched 1 x 2.5 m doorway), "Arcade Wall – Arch Opening" (open 1 x 2.5 m arch with crystal keystone), "Arcade Wall – End Cap" (iron chain swag). Row 3 upper-floor deadwood timber-frame walls, each 2 x 3 m: "Timber Wall – Plain" (X brace), "Timber Wall – Window", "Timber Wall – Door", "Oriel Bay – Window 2 x 3 m (proj. 1 m)" with a small terracotta hood. Row 4: "Outer Corner 0.5 x 3 m" and "Inner Corner 0.5 x 3 m" (slim square posts, basalt lower half, deadwood upper half), "Corner Tower Segment 2 x 3 m (r 1 m)" (one round basalt storey with deadwood windows, no roof), "Floor Tile 2 x 2 m" (0.5 m thick cobbled slab), "Straight Stairs 2 x 3 m (run 4 m)", "Balcony (Railing) 2 x 1 m (proj. 1 m)". No other pieces, no banners or roofs that are not listed. Show each piece as an orthographic front elevation (no perspective) with a small three-quarter view beside it, on faint module grid lines, with its name and size (for example "3 x 4 m") in the label. Thick, solid forms, no thin parts. A plain neutral 1.8 m human silhouette labelled "1.8 m" stands on the sheet for scale, with everything at true scale to it. Title at the top: "Accord kit: structure".
